experiments.what: Hourly golden-task canary over every free engine; agents prefer the healthy ones.
experiments.method: canary testing (the standard for API health)

experiments.what: When something blocks EXCAVA, it searches its OWN 6.8k-element hub for a tool that solves it and attaches the candidates to the pitch.
Departments missing a lead/doer/checker get the missing role added automatically (tier 2.5 autonomy, labeled 'Added by EXCAVA').

Run the same goal with two team shapes (e.g. 2 vs 5 agents, debate vs solo) and an independent judge picks the better artifact; the winner becomes the default. Tally: debate 1 — solo 4; latest winner: debate.

Take one huge goal, decompose into small verified steps, execute step-by-step with a checkpoint after each — the skill EXCAVA needs for big jobs. Walking: 'Close the link gap: 4767 of 8311 elements have no verified l' — 1/6 checkpoints done.
A fixed suite of tasks EXCAVA once did well, re-run after every self-change; any score drop auto-reverts the change (tier-2 self-code gate). Latest score: 100% (6/6 tasks).
experiments.method: regression testing (how real software ships safely)
